description: This file implements the ServerControllerImpl class, which manages server-side control logic for IPC, including handling client references, failure states, and cancellation support (which is not implemented).

classes.name: ServerControllerImpl
classes.description: Implements server-side control logic for IPC, managing client references, failure states, and cancellation.

methods.name: ServerControllerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server controller with a client shared pointer and serial ID.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure state with a reason string.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the operation has been canceled; always returns false as cancel is unsupported.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback for cancellation notification; not supported, so callback is ignored.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the associated client.
